title: Seeing is Free, Speaking is Not: Uncovering the True Energy Bottleneck in Edge VLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2607.09520v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the perceptual backbone of embodied AI, but their energy footprint on edge hardware remains poorly understood. Existing efficiency efforts focus predominantly on reducing visual tokens, implicitly treating visual processing as the dominant energy cost. We overturn this implicit assumption through the first systematic energy profiling of on-device VLM inference, spanning five models across three architecture families, four input resolutions, and two hardware platforms (NVIDIA RTX 3070 and Jetson Orin NX). translated_title: 看见是免费的，说话不是：揭示边缘VLM推理中真正的能量瓶颈
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）是具身AI的感知骨干，但它们在边缘硬件上的能耗足迹仍鲜为人知。现有的效率研究主要集中于减少视觉标记，隐含地将视觉处理视为主要能量成本。我们通过首次对设备端VLM推理进行系统性能量分析，推翻了这一隐含假设，该分析涵盖三个架构家族的五个模型、四种输入分辨率以及两个硬件平台（NVIDIA RTX 3070和Jetson Orin NX）。我们的分析得出三个发现。首先，平均推理功率是模型固有的常数，不受输入分辨率、图像复杂度和提示类型的影响，在所有条件下变化小于5%。这意味着所有输入间的能量变化必须来自推理时间的变化，而非功率消耗的变化。其次，每个输出标记的墙钟时间成本比视觉处理高出11到39倍。
tldr: 该论文通过系统性能量分析发现，边缘VLM推理的真正能量瓶颈在于输出文本生成，而非视觉处理，因为推理功率恒定且每个输出标记的时间成本远高于视觉处理。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through systematic energy profiling that the true energy bottleneck in edge VLM inference lies in output text generation, not visual processing, as inference power is constant and each output token costs far more time than visual processing.
